data.one_liner: Obsolete package that once bundled native SQLite libraries for Flutter; now contains no code.
data.what_it_does: The package used to provide platform‑specific SQLite binaries for Flutter apps. As of version 0.6.0 it is empty and only serves to signal that the old scripts should not be used. It is deprecated in favor of the sqlite3 package version 3.x.
use_when: You need a dependency that guarantees the old Flutter‑specific SQLite build scripts are not included after migrating to sqlite3 3.x.
avoid_when: You need actual SQLite functionality in your app.
You are starting a new project and want to use SQLite.
strengths: Helps enforce removal of outdated native scripts.
weaknesses: Provides no features beyond a placeholder.

alternatives.name: sqlite3
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides full SQLite functionality and is actively maintained.
